correctness.rationale: Kummer transforms valuations into total carries for n+2n. The exact 3-state matrix, initial vector and final weight reproduce this total, including the upper terminal carry. The determinant and numerator reduce over Q(z,t); the derivative at z=1 proves the closed mean; dominant eigenvalue derivatives (1 and 4/3 at lambda=2) yield mean slope 1/2 and variance slope 11/12 and the characteristic-function limit. The no-single-carry and Fibonacci zero cases follow from the carry process. Exact independent computation checked all n in dyadic blocks up to 2^16, and separately verified carries to 2^13, without substituting enumeration for proof.

originality.rationale: Claim-to-claim comparison in the closest inspected primary sources found only fixed-row valuation counts, related-quotient divisibility, fibbinary zero support, and analytic binomial series. No result that directly states or dominates the exact two-variable diagonal dyadic frequency law was identified. Because literature search is bounded, this is not a uniqueness certificate.

The 2016 and 2017 Spiegelhofer–Wallner papers were checked for definitions, theorem domains and terms but not exhaustively line-by-line; an implicit stronger general framework may cover the claim.

value.rationale: The theorem gives all coefficient frequencies of the 2-adic valuation of binomial(3n,n) in each dyadic interval. The zero layer was known through no-adjacent-one digits, but all positive valuation layers and their fluctuations were not explicitly classified in the inspected sources. This exact bivariate generating function and normal law isolate a natural arithmetic statistic and do not rest on a selected finite range.
